transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this case-review meeting. As you know, we have a student currently living in Maple Hall who has requested an emergency move following a serious roommate conflict. Before I issue a decision on the relocation and associated support plan, I'd like to hear from both of you. Could the residence life coordinator share any relevant information about the situation in Maple Hall and the availability of temporary housing options? And could the counseling center director provide any relevant background that might inform the support plan? I want to make sure we have a complete picture before I approve the relocation and finalize the written plan covering the new residence, move timing, contact boundaries, and follow-up support.

transcript.text: I need to flag an important update before we proceed. I confirmed with facilities this morning that Cedar Hall is actually closed for plumbing repairs. The only available room right now is in Oak Hall — it can be occupied Sunday at 4:00 p.m. and is available under a 14-day temporary housing license. I should note that the housing dashboard still lists Cedar as available because the closure was posted after its nightly update, so anyone checking the dashboard would see outdated information.
